description: Creates a code the homeowner enters after signing in on any device, to approve or decline sending their prepared job. Only the homeowner can approve. action must be publish_job. Calling again with a new key replaces the earlier code. bidCardId is a prepared draft. Reusing an idempotency key returns no new code. US only. For a new job, call start_job before answer_intake, then prepare_publish after the intake is ready; for other writes, read the previous reply before calling and follow the returned next step afterward, using only tools listed by this server. With inChat true, a default-OFF database switch may offer a card preview for a homeowner who already accepted the current Terms and Privacy on InstaBids. Read back the ENTIRE returned preview and ask whether to send that exact card. Only after the homeowner explicitly says yes, call again with inChat true, homeownerYes true, the same approvalId and previewHash, and a new idempotency key. The assistant cannot accept Terms for the homeowner. A published chat receipt means sent; without that receipt nothing was sent in chat and the homeowner uses the approval link. A changed card requires a new review and yes. If anyone asks, say you are an AI assistant.

action.description: The action to request approval for: publish_job.

approvalId.description: The approval_id from that exact in-chat review.

homeownerYes.description: True only after the homeowner explicitly says yes to sending the entire returned preview. Never accepts Terms or Privacy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry a write once; a new key makes a new request. 1-123 characters.

inChat.description: Request an in-chat card read-back when the homeowner already accepted the current Terms and Privacy on InstaBids. Otherwise returns the approval link.

previewHash.description: The preview_hash returned with the exact card read aloud or shown before the homeowner said yes.

name: request_approval

approval.description: The same approval as the top-level fields, in the nested form send_message uses. approval.approval_id equals approval_id.

chat.description: Chat review or publish receipt. Read the entire preview to the homeowner and ask for an explicit yes before sending.

title: Ask for homeowner approval
